saints.name: Frumentius
saints.legacy: Apostle of Ethiopia and early Christian leader
saints.summary: Saint Frumentius was a child taken to Ethiopia with his brother Edesius after their ship was attacked. He became a trusted advisor to the Ethiopian king and later was consecrated as the first bishop of Ethiopia by Saint Athanasius. Through his efforts, he successfully spread Christianity throughout the nation, fulfilling a prophecy from Isaiah.
